notes.text: /withdraw opens a window of crafting sets. Pick one, choose ×1, ×10, ×20 or ×50, press Withdraw: the ingredients come out of your Cart and Storage.
Poison Bottle (Create Deadly Poison), Fireproof, Coldproof, Earthproof and Thunderproof Potion, and a full Twilight Alchemy 3 cast. Reset presets brings them back if you edit or delete one.
What you already carry is never taken again, the Cart is used before the Storage, and the Storage is only opened when the Cart is not enough.
Not enough for every craft? It prepares as many as it can and says in red which item ran short. When nothing can be made, it lists what is missing.
notes.details: A weight or slot refusal from the server also gets its own red line, with the reason.

notes.text: Write a set as one craft, one item per line: 2 Frill, Red Gemstone x1, or an item id. A Creation Guide goes on a line with no number: it is taken once, never multiplied.
